recognize_zh: 中央一個大型組織球，細胞質充滿泡沫狀空泡，並吞噬數個小的深染核狀物（噬血現象），右側及上方另有細胞質偏藍的非典型大細胞；血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（尤其亞洲型）常合併噬血症候群。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant foamy, coarsely vacuolated cytoplasm
Engulfed small dense nuclear bodies and cellular debris within the histiocyte (hemophagocytosis)
Adjacent large atypical cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm
Background erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and granulocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant foamy vacuolated cytoplasm containing phagocytosed small nucleated cells and nuclear debris, consistent with hemophagocytosis. Nearby are large atypical mononuclear cells with fine chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, within a background of residual hematopoietic cells. Hemophagocytosis is a nonspecific finding but is a recognized association of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, particularly the hemophagocytic syndrome-associated variant. Findings are suggestive of lymphoma-associated hemophagocytosis in the setting of intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Morphology of the hemophagocytic histiocyte is identical, so exclusion of lymphoma requires a biopsy with CD20 staining to look for intrasinusoidal large B cells.
Neoplastic cells are CD3/CD56 and EBER positive rather than CD20/PAX5 positive large B cells.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm without engulfed hematopoietic cells.
